Created `tests/com/google/gson/internal/bind/ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactoryAgentTest.java` (JUnit 4, since both 3.8.2 and 4.12 are present in `lib/`). It is self-contained — fixture POJOs and a reflection-based helper to construct a `ConstructorConstructor` instance (needed to call the public `ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory` constructor, whose other dependency types `Excluder`/`FieldNamingPolicy` are used directly) are defined inline.

Coverage, grounded in the `api/` javadoc:
- Structural contract: class is `public final` and implements `TypeAdapterFactory`; `Adapter` is `public final` and extends `TypeAdapter`.
- `create(Gson, TypeToken)`: returns `null` for primitive types ("doesn't support type"), returns a `TypeAdapter`/`Adapter` instance for a POJO, round-trips ordinary fields, excludes transient/static fields from output, handles `null` on write/read per the `write`/`read` javadoc ("may be null"), handles a zero-field class, and throws for a `null` type (boundary case).
- `excludeField(Field, boolean)` / package-private `excludeField(Field, boolean, Excluder)`: since the javadoc gives no behavioral description, I avoided guessing the return-value polarity and instead asserted the implied delegation — the instance overload must agree with the static overload given the same excluder — plus boundary cases (`null` field, `null` excluder) expected to fail.

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
